title: Message Batches results come back in a different order than the requests were submitted
symptoms: Answers are attached to the wrong input rows
The result for the second request arrives before the first
cause: Batch results can be returned in any order, not in submission order, so pairing results with inputs by position mislabels them.
fix: Give every request a unique custom_id (1 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores) and join results on it. Handle each result type: succeeded, errored, canceled, expired.
affected: Message Batches API, all models, as of 2026-10
